n01.speaker: aiden
n01.text: In my town, your head shows the last thing you said.

n02.speaker: aiden
n02.text: Most of the time, it's something nice.

n04.speaker: aiden
n04.text: I said it to my sister, three weeks ago.

n05.speaker: aiden
n05.text: Then I stopped talking. So it stayed.

n06.speaker: aiden
n06.text: Since Mom got sick, Ava did everything.

a02.speaker: af_heart
a02.text: Eat your dinner. I'll be back late.

n07.speaker: aiden
n07.text: She never smiled. She never said anything nice.

n08.speaker: aiden
n08.text: Every night she left. So one night, I followed her.

n09.speaker: aiden
n09.text: She went to the hospital. To Mom.

m01.speaker: af_sarah
m01.text: She comes every night. She only ever talks about you.

n10.speaker: aiden
n10.text: The last thing she said was about me.

n11.speaker: aiden
n11.text: For three weeks, my head said I hate you.

n12.speaker: aiden
n12.text: It only took three words to fix it.
